title: Prembly Simplifies Global Business Expansion With Unified Trust Infrastructure
summary: Prembly helps businesses expand across markets with unified identity verification, KYB, AML screening, background checks, fraud intelligence, and ongoing monitoring.
body_markdown:
Prembly is helping businesses expand across borders with unified infrastructure for identity verification, KYB, AML screening, background checks, fraud intelligence, and ongoing monitoring across emerging and developed markets.


For businesses expanding internationally, entering a new market is rarely just a question of finding customers but also answering the critical question of who you’re doing business with.


While each market comes with different identity systems, data sources, regulatory requirements, fraud patterns, and ways of establishing trust, having the right infrastructure to access, verify, and continuously understand data across markets is essential.


When businesses operate across multiple markets, managing this complexity can quickly become a barrier to growth. This gets even harder when expanding into emerging markets, putting together multiple providers for identity verification, business verification, AML screening, background checks and fraud prevention.


The common result is often a fragmented compliance stack that is expensive to maintain and difficult to scale. Prembly is built to simplify this complexity, serving as a 360° partner for identity, fraud, and verification needs, so businesses can expand with greater confidence and without the added operational burden.


## One Partner for Doing Business Globally


Prembly brings identity verification, KYB, AML screening, background checks, fraud intelligence and ongoing monitoring together on a single platform. Businesses can verify who they are dealing with, assess risk before entering a relationship, and continue monitoring that relationship as circumstances change.


Its verification and compliance infrastructure is designed to support businesses operating across emerging economies and developed markets, including Africa, Latin America, North America and Europe.


Its fraud intelligence platform, FraudLens, also powers fraud data and behavioural intelligence to help businesses assess current database, identify emerging risks and prevent repeat fraud. This creates a more complete view of risk rather than relying on a single check at the point of onboarding.


This matters particularly for businesses whose growth strategy extends beyond their home market. For instance:


- A US-based fintech expanding into Africa may need to verify customers in multiple countries.
- A global marketplace may need to establish that its merchants are legitimate businesses.
- A payments company screening customers and businesses against AML requirements while monitoring transactions for suspicious activity.
- A global employer conducting background checks on candidates in different jurisdictions.


The underlying requirement remains the same, know who you’re dealing with, understand the risk, and stay on top of monitoring.


With over 7000+ businesses that we support, including London Stock Exchange, Mastercard, Uber, and others. Expanding internationally is made easier and simpler with Prembly. We have the fraud infrastructure to help businesses focus on growth opportunities while we support with end-to-end compliance.


## About Prembly


Prembly is the leading compliance and security infrastructure company building the rails for trust in emerging markets. We provide a unified, Al-powered platform that authenticates identities, performs background checks, and monitors transactions in real-time. We enable digital businesses to safely acquire and onboard customers across borders without restrictions, ensuring they deal only with the right people.
